Against a white wall with floral arrangements, the groom in the dark suit (R1) stands on the left in profile, resting his left hand on the right shoulder of the bride in the strapless white gown (R2). The bride stands on the right, holding a pastel bouquet and looking up at him with a gentle smile. Her sheer veil drapes behind her. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the scene, creating a clean, romantic atmosphere with neutral tones.
